name: LibraX Invoice
author: libraxnet

sections.description:
LibraX Invoice is a clean and high-performance WooCommerce invoicing plugin. It provides Invoice, Proforma Invoice, Packing Slip, and Credit Note — all core features are completely free.

Designed with simplicity in mind, the plugin only has 14 settings while delivering fast PDF generation and polished document layouts. It includes 5 beautiful templates and excellent compatibility with popular WooCommerce extensions.

Key Features
* Generate Invoice, Proforma Invoice, Packing Slip, and Credit Note
* Automatic PDF attachment to emails (following standard e-commerce logic)
* Customers can download documents from My Account page (Invoice, Proforma Invoice, and Credit Note)
* 5 high-quality templates (default, alpha, gamma, delta, kappa)
* Bulk download Invoice & Packing Slip as ZIP from admin
* Supports Tax ID fields (e.g. VAT, SSN, EIN, ABN, CPF, CNPJ, GSTIN and more)
* Sequential invoice numbering with year prefix
* Compatible with WooCommerce Subscriptions, Bookings, Product Add-Ons, and YITH Product Add-Ons
* Company logo, primary color, custom bank details, and invoice notes
* Proforma with payment QR code for manually created orders (great for offline/service businesses)
* Full CJK support (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) via MiSans font

Automatic Behaviors
* Completed order → Invoice attached to email
* Refund issued → Credit Note attached to refund email
* Bank Transfer orders → Proforma attached to notification email
* Manually created pending orders → Proforma with QR code can be attached when sending order details
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/librax-invoice directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → PDF Invoices to configure the settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin have any paid features or Pro version?

No. All core features are free.

Does it support WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes. The plugin is fully compatible with HPOS.

Can customers download invoices from My Account?

Yes. Customers can view and download Invoice, Proforma Invoice, and Credit Note directly from their account.

Is sequential invoice numbering supported?

Yes. You can enable sequential numbering with year prefix (e.g. 20261001), and it resets automatically each year.

Can I customize or add my own templates?

Yes. You can add custom templates by placing them in your theme folder:
your-theme/librax-invoice/templates/
We strongly recommend using a child theme to avoid losing your custom templates when updating your main theme.

Does it support Chinese, Japanese and Korean?

Yes. The plugin provides full CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) support via MiSans font.
